tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The default surface for every Kosh page, slide and screen.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and table rows that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, the background of a conflict panel's comparison strip.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and the logo on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk`. 15.9:1 on paper (light), 16:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, source lines and dates on `paper` and `paper-raised`. 5.9:1 (light), 7.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders. Kosh separates with lines, never shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; must hold 3:1 against `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The brand colour, from sindoor. The Source Dot, primary buttons, the logo dot, chart highlight. A fill or mark only on light (3.2:1 on paper); never body text on light.

tokens.name: on-vermilion
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `vermilion` fill. Ink, not white: 5.0:1 (light), 5.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: vermilion-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion as text: links, the active tab label, inline emphasis on `paper`. 5.5:1 (light), 7.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: vermilion-wash
tokens.usage: Selected rows, highlighted cells, the background of a brief's key decision box. Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Status: a fact confirmed by two or more independent sources. Always paired with the word 'Verified' or a filled Source Dot. 5.6:1 (light) on paper.

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Status: sources disagree. Paired with the word 'Conflict' and a split dot. 4.6:1 (light), 8.8:1 (dark) on paper.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Status: single source, or older than 12 months. Paired with the word 'Single source' or 'Dated'. 4.9:1 (light) on paper.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Second data series in charts and maps (vermilion is the first). Never used for UI chrome.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 2px `ink` outline offset 2px. Holds well above 3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: statement-xl
styles.sample: Before you sign a ten-year lease, know what's true.
styles.usage: One big claim per slide or page hero. Instrument Serif, never bold.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Section openers, pull-quotes, the brief's verdict line.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in the product; slide titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Karnataka reimburses half of your rent for three years if you hire 50+ people.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, button text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: Source lines, dates, IDs. Always muted, always beside the number it backs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its Source Dot.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page section rhythm; slide margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The Source Dot and status dots only.
